author: donotreviv3
body:
Ragnarok coming up at the end segment of this month's event schedule. If you don't yet have the event pets from this especially the arisen spirit garm you will want to pick them up they're all useful and the spirit garm is a nuke for most raids.

Gerd or <Fey Gerd's (from fey jormundr) gear all has good bonuses for a BeoA build featuring good pet stats, added bestial bond, excellent ward numbers and split defense / res stats.

Friendship buff amity for extra pet stats up to 15% I believe

Also consider from this event (throne makers) the great sphinx raid drops a head piece / leg piece with skill gods of aaru which is a 2 turn deific channel you can use in a quick cast celestial staff build to achieve a 1 turn deific channel and quicker pet damage for raids and other content.

author: sirdhov
body:
You should look to Zagreus, Gerd, Sumner itens and adorments from Osiris, that gives 1% stats and 1% action. That could make you hit like a truck if you already have the arisen spiritgarm. 
I'm main deity, but my beoA with 2 al has reach the number between 5-9m. 

You just need to know that Bestial Bond with YOUR high status will make your pets seens like Rambo.

body: Hi, just wanted to tell you that your build is decent! Your head piece and shield are a little lower rolled but you’ve got the right items! I would be looking to maximize my ward with surtr cuirass and fey feed or chimaera legs or arisen pumpkinless.
